Stipple.text: Stipple is the style's dash pattern, one of the Stipple constants.

StippleScale.text:
StippleScale is how far apart the dashes of a stippled line are, in
the unit Style.WidthAs names.

String.text: String is the style's name, as the styles list shows it.

TextAlign.text:
TextAlign is where the text of a dimension sits against its anchor:
horizontal is "left", "center" or "right", vertical is "bottom",
"center" or "top".

TextAngle.text:
TextAngle is the angle in degrees the text of a dimension is drawn
at.

TextHeight.text:
TextHeight is the height of the text of a dimension drawn in the
style, in the unit Style.TextHeightAs names.

TextHeightAs.text:
TextHeightAs is whether the text height is in pixels or in the
document's unit.

Valid.text: Valid reports whether the style is still in the drawing.

Visible.text: Visible reports whether lines in the style are drawn.

Width.text: Width is the style's line width, in the unit Style.WidthAs names.

WidthAs.text:
WidthAs is whether the width and the stipple width are in pixels or
in the document's unit.

ZIndex.text:
ZIndex is how high the style is drawn: of the styles in one group,
the one with the highest index goes on top, and a file's entities
are exported in that order too. It is what puts a dimension over the
geometry it measures.

SuppressMode.text: SuppressMode is how much of a group is left out of the model.

SweepGroup.text:
SweepGroup is the view of a sweep along a path: its twist, the
radius of its corners and which way is up.

CornerRadius.text:
CornerRadius is a sweep's corner radius in mm, 0 where its corners
are mitred.

SetCornerRadius.text:
SetCornerRadius rounds a sweep's corners on its path by mm: at each
corner the pieces either side are cut back to where an arc of the
radius, tangent to both, joins them, and the profile turns about the
arc's axis, so the solid is exact and needs no surface intersected.
Corners beside an arc need one, which a mitre can't join; 0 mitres
the corners between lines again. A radius too large for a piece, too
small for the profile to clear the arc's axis, or a corner out of an
arc's plane, is a problem on the group. SetExpr with
sketch.GroupPitch gives it an expression.

SetSweepUp.text:
SetSweepUp holds a sweep's frames to the direction up, as far as the
path's tangent allows, rather than turning them as little as the path
lets them: a profile swept along a helix with up its axis keeps
facing the axis, as a thread's does. The path must never run along
up. Zero turns them least again.

SetTwist.text:
SetTwist turns a sweep's profile about the path by degrees over the
whole of it, evenly along its length: a square swept along a line and
twisted by 90 is a twisted bar. A twisted sweep's surface is fitted
to the true one within a tenth of the chord tolerance, as a sweep
along a cubic is. SetExpr with sketch.GroupValC gives it an
expression.

SweepUp.text:
SweepUp is the direction a sweep holds its frames to, or zero when
they turn as little as the path lets them.

Twist.text:
Twist is how far a sweep turns its profile about the path over the
whole of it, in degrees.

ThreadOptions.text:
ThreadOptions are what Features > Screw Thread asks for. The zero
value is what the screen starts with: the standard thread nearest
the circle's diameter, external, one and a half diameters long,
ending at a shoulder.

Vec.text: Vec is a point or a direction in space, in mm.

ViewMenu.text:
ViewMenu holds the calls of the View menu that change what the
drawing shows: the section, the units of dimensions and the
appearance of faces. A script reaches it as doc.View.

ClearSection.text: ClearSection turns the section view off.

FaceAppearance.text:
FaceAppearance is the appearance the face has: its own, its group's,
or "" for the default.

MmPerUnit.text:
MmPerUnit is the size in mm of the unit the user interface shows
lengths in.

Section.text:
Section is the section view's state and its cut of the active
group's solid.

SetFaceAppearance.decl: func (m ViewMenu) SetFaceAppearance(face SolidFace, name string)
SetFaceAppearance.text:
SetFaceAppearance gives one face of the solid its own appearance, or
with "" takes it away, so that the face has its group's. The face is
kept by its identity, in the group that made it.

SetSection.decl: func (m ViewMenu) SetSection(plane Entity, offset string, flip bool)
SetSection.text:
SetSection turns the section view on: the solid is drawn cut by a
plane parallel to plane, a workplane or a planar face, offset along
its normal (a number or an expression in the document's unit, ""
for none), the side the normal points to taken away, or the other
side with flip. It is a way of looking, as View > Section View is:
not saved and not undone. Render draws it too.

SetUnits.text:
SetUnits makes u the document's unit, keeping every size, as View >
Dimension Units does: a length expression is rewritten to give the
same length in u, "(1/4)*25.4" for "1/4" from inches to mm. It
returns the parameters that lengths are computed from, which now
count in u.

Units.text:
Units is the document's unit of length: what lengths typed as text,
in Constraint.SetExpr and Group.SetExpr and in the user interface,
are in. Every other length this package takes or gives is in mm.

Appearances.text:
Appearances are the appearances a solid or a face can have, how it
takes light when the window shades (roadmap 19.2): matte, plastic,
glossy and metal.

Commands.text:
Commands lists the commands of the main menu as the command search
(Edit > Find Command) shows them, "Menu > Entry", for RunCommand.
In a script the interpreter binds it to the host's; a program
compiled on its own has no interface, and none.

Current.text:
Current is the document the script was run on: the drawing on screen
in the application, the file named on the command line of the
command-line tool, or a new sketch. A script compiled as a program
of its own gets a new sketch too, unless it called SetCurrent.

Import.text:
Import converts the SolveSpace model src (.slvs) to the TeleSAPR
model dst (.tlspr), and opens it. Every SolveSpace model src links is
converted too, to a .tlspr file beside it, and the links are pointed
at those; a converted file that exists already is used as it is. The
.slvs files are not changed. It fails when a linked file is missing,
when the links form a cycle, or when a file can't be written.

Inch.text: Inch is v inches in mm.

MenuEntriesOf.text:
MenuEntriesOf lists the menu entries a call stands for, as
"Features > Extrude", in order.

MenuEntryCalls.decl: func MenuEntryCalls(entry string) (path string, calls []string, why string, ok bool)
MenuEntryCalls.text:
MenuEntryCalls is what a script calls in place of a menu entry,
written "Features > Fillet Edges" or "Features/Fillet Edges": the
calls, or why there are none. It reports false when no entry has
that path.

New.text:
New is a new, empty sketch, as File > New makes: the three reference
workplanes and a group to draw in, in the XY plane.

NewDoc.text:
NewDoc is the document of a host. The application makes the one a
script gets from Current; a program of its own makes them with New
and Open.

NewSketchHost.text:
NewSketchHost hosts sk, which was loaded from or will be saved to
saveFile ("" for none).

Open.text:
Open loads a sketch from a .tlspr file. A SolveSpace model (.slvs) is
converted with Import instead.

SetCurrent.text: SetCurrent sets what Current returns in a compiled program.

ThreadNearest.text:
ThreadNearest is the designation of the standard thread whose major
diameter is nearest d mm, as the screw thread screen first offers.

V.decl: func V(x, y, z float64) Vec
V.text: V is the vector (x, y, z).

Assemble.text: How a group's solid combines with the solid so far.

Difference.text: How a group's solid combines with the solid so far.

ErrNotStylable.text:
ErrNotStylable is what a style given to a request or a constraint the
window can't style gives: a point, a workplane, a normal, or a
constraint other than a comment.

Intersection.text: How a group's solid combines with the solid so far.

MaxSegmentsLimit.text:
The range of a curve's pieces, display or export, as the
configuration screen allows.

MenuCalls.text:
MenuCalls says, for each entry of the window's main menu, by its path
("Features/Extrude"), the calls a script makes instead, as help()
names them ("Features.Extrude"; several separated by spaces), or,
after "- ", why the entry has none: most of those are the window's
own, its view and its panels, which a script has none of. A test of
the package holds it to the menu, both ways.

MeshCustom.text: The mesh export presets, as the export dialog offers them.

MeshDraft.text: The mesh export presets, as the export dialog offers them.

MeshFine.text: The mesh export presets, as the export dialog offers them.

MeshStandard.text: The mesh export presets, as the export dialog offers them.

MinSegments.text:
The range of a curve's pieces, display or export, as the
configuration screen allows.

StippleContinuous.text:
The stipple patterns a line may be drawn in, as the style screen
lists them.

StippleDash.text:
The stipple patterns a line may be drawn in, as the style screen
lists them.

StippleDashDot.text:
The stipple patterns a line may be drawn in, as the style screen
lists them.

StippleDashDotDot.text:
The stipple patterns a line may be drawn in, as the style screen
lists them.

StippleDot.text:
The stipple patterns a line may be drawn in, as the style screen
lists them.

StippleFreehand.text:
The stipple patterns a line may be drawn in, as the style screen
lists them.

StippleLongDash.text:
The stipple patterns a line may be drawn in, as the style screen
lists them.

StippleShortDash.text:
The stipple patterns a line may be drawn in, as the style screen
lists them.

StippleZigzag.text:
The stipple patterns a line may be drawn in, as the style screen
lists them.

SuppressSolid.text:
The suppress modes: nothing left out, the solid only, or the whole
group with every group that uses it.

SuppressWhole.text:
The suppress modes: nothing left out, the solid only, or the whole
group with every group that uses it.

Union.text: How a group's solid combines with the solid so far.

UnitsMM.text:
The units a line's width, its dashes and a dimension's text are
measured in: the screen's pixels, or millimetres.

UnitsPixels.text:
The units a line's width, its dashes and a dimension's text are
measured in: the screen's pixels, or millimetres.

Unsuppressed.text:
The suppress modes: nothing left out, the solid only, or the whole
group with every group that uses it.

github.com/telesapr/telesapr/pkg/sketch.name: sketch
github.com/telesapr/telesapr/pkg/sketch.text: Package sketch is the model: the groups of a part's history, with their requests, constraints and solids, and what regenerates them.

AssemblyPart.text: AssemblyPart is a part of an assembly as a STEP file gives it (roadmap 16.8): a linked file's solid in the file's own coordinates, placed by the link's rotation and offset, so that a file linked twice is one product placed twice; or another group's solid, where it is.

BOMItem.text: BOMItem is a line of the bill of materials: the parts from one file.

BrokenReference.text: BrokenReference is a request, constraint or group that a regeneration deleted, because something it referred to was gone.

String.text: String says what was deleted and why: "deleted c012-pt-pt-distance of g004-sketch-in-plane, which used r005-line-segment of g002-sketch-in-plane".

Clipboard.text: Clipboard holds copied requests, and the constraints among them.

ContainsEntity.text: ContainsEntity reports whether he, or no entity, was copied.

NewEntityFor.text: NewEntityFor is the pasted entity for copied entity he.

ClipboardRequest.text: ClipboardRequest is a copied request: its points in the workplane's coordinates, and the entities it came from.

Configuration.text: Configuration is a named set of parameter expressions, by name.

CopyAs.text: CopyAs is the transformation a copied entity gets.

CopyPlacement.text: CopyPlacement is where a group that copies a solid puts one copy: the source scaled by Scale about the origin, 1, or -1 for a reflection (a point inversion, which the half turn in Move makes a mirror), then moved by Move.

Dependency.text: Dependency is one group that another group needs, and the first reason found for it.

Check.text: Check reports what is wrong with the drawing's settings.

Clone.text: Clone is a copy of the drawing that shares nothing with it; nil for none.

DimensionView.decl: func (d *Drawing) DimensionView(view string) (n int, ok bool)
DimensionView.text: DimensionView is what a dimension's view names: a view kind (front, ..., iso), or the n-th section or detail by its letter, sections first; n is -1 for a view kind, and ok false when it names none.

Layout.text: Layout places the views: the drawing's own, or the standard ones, front, top, a side and the isometric, by the projection's convention, given each view's width and height on the model in mm (sizes, by kind).

PlaceDetail.decl: func (d *Drawing) PlaceDetail(i int, x, y float64) error
PlaceDetail.text: PlaceDetail puts the i-th detail with its middle at x, y mm on the sheet; 0, 0 gives it back to the automatic placing.

PlaceExtras.text: PlaceExtras places the sections and details that have no place, in columns to the right of the views, from the top down, given each one's size on the sheet in mm, the sections' first; right is where the views end.

PlaceSection.decl: func (d *Drawing) PlaceSection(i int, x, y float64) error
PlaceSection.text: PlaceSection puts the i-th section with its middle at x, y mm on the sheet; 0, 0 gives it back to the automatic placing.

PlaceView.decl: func (d *Drawing) PlaceView(kind string, x, y float64) error
PlaceView.text: PlaceView shows the view of the given kind with its middle at x, y mm from the sheet's bottom left, moving it if the drawing shows it already.

RemoveView.text: RemoveView stops showing the view of that kind.

Size.text: Size is the drawing's sheet in mm, turned as it is.

ViewIndex.text: ViewIndex is the position of the view of that kind in Views, or -1 when the drawing does not show it.

DrawingDetail.text: DrawingDetail is a detail view (roadmap 18.3): the part of View within R mm of the point CX, CY (mm right and up from the view's middle, on the model), enlarged Scale times the sheet's scale; at X, Y on the sheet, or placed when both are 0.

DrawingDimension.text: DrawingDimension is a dimension on a view of the drawing (roadmap 18.4, H2): the length of an edge, the distance between two, or the diameter or radius of a circular one, the edges held by their names (step 9), so that it measures them again as the model changes.

DrawingSection.text: DrawingSection is a section view (roadmap 18.3): the solid cut by the plane square to View's direction through the solid's middle, moved Offset mm toward the viewer, the half beyond seen, the cut face hatched; at X, Y on the sheet, or placed when both are 0.

DrawingView.text: DrawingView is a view on the sheet: what it looks at, from where, and where its middle is on the sheet, in mm from the bottom left.

EdgeRadius.text: EdgeRadius is a fillet's radius for one of its edges, Edge counting Edges and then SolidEdges: Val millimetres, from Expr when it is not "".

EntityBezierResolver.text: EntityBezierResolver is the lookup interface that GenerateEntityBeziers needs to evaluate entity points, normals, and radii at solve time.

ExportSettings.text: ExportSettings are the user's export settings.

ChordTolMm.text: ChordTolMm is the export chord tolerance in mm.

ExprError.text: ExprError is a stored expression of a constraint or a group that could not be evaluated.

FaceAppearance.text: FaceAppearance is a face's own appearance, by the face's identity.

Freedom.text: Freedom is how much of an entity its group's constraints fix.

GenerateType.text: GenerateType is which groups GenerateAll solves: all of them; from the first dirty or unsolved one to the active one; none, only regenerating the entities; up to the active one; or, for a group just added, from the first dirty one to the active one, and all of them if the chord tolerance changes.

AssembleLoops.decl: func (g *Group) AssembleLoops(sk *Sketch, rt EntityBezierResolver) (allClosed, allCoplanar, allNonZeroLen bool)
AssembleLoops.text: AssembleLoops converts this group's visible, non-construction entities into Bezier curves and assembles them into closed loops: the outer loops grouped with their holes go into g.BezierLoops (and their pwl into g.PolyLoops), the leftovers into g.BezierOpens.

Clear.text: Clear drops everything regeneration makes, and the remap table.

CopyEntity.decl: func (g *Group) CopyEntity(sk *Sketch, el *[]core.Entity, ep *core.Entity, timesApplied, remap int, dx, dy, dz, qw, qvx, qvy, qvz, dist core.HParam, as CopyAs)
CopyEntity.text: CopyEntity appends a transformed copy of ep.

CopyPlacements.decl: func (g *Group) CopyPlacements(sk *Sketch) (places []CopyPlacement, ofSolid bool, err error)
CopyPlacements.text: CopyPlacements lists where a step and repeat (translate or rotate), a pattern along a path or a mirror puts the copies of its source's solid, the copies the kernel unites into the group's own solid (generateFor- StepAndRepeatShell, generatePatternShell, generateMirrorShell).

DescriptionString.text: DescriptionString names the group as the property browser does: "g003-extrude".

DraftNeutral.text: DraftNeutral is how far along the extrusion, from the sketch's plane, the neutral plane of its draft lies, in mm.

EdgeRadius.text: EdgeRadius is the radius a fillet gives its edge i, counting Edges and then SolidEdges, and its expression: the edge's own, or the group's.

ExtrusionForceVectorTo.text: ExtrusionForceVectorTo sets the extrusion vector's parameters.

ExtrusionGetVector.text: ExtrusionGetVector returns the extrusion vector, from its parameters.

FaceProblem.text: FaceProblem is why a sketch on a face did not find its face at the last regeneration, or "": the workplane then stays where it was.

FieldName.text: FieldName is the value's name in the file and in messages for this group: a chamfer's distance is ValB, as a helix's pitch is.

Generate.text: Generate creates this group's entities and params.

GenerateDisplayItems.text: GenerateDisplayItems builds the mesh and outlines to display: the previous group's, if this group adds no solid, else the running shell triangulated, with the running mesh.

GenerateEquations.text: GenerateEquations appends the group's own equations.

GenerateLoops.text: GenerateLoops rebuilds this group's loops: for sketch-like groups it assembles them from the group's entities and records the polygon error, otherwise it just clears them.

GenerateShellAndMesh.text: GenerateShellAndMesh builds this group's shell (by extrusion, revolution, step and repeat, or linking), and combines it with the previous group's running shell by the group's Boolean.

HasAppearance.text: HasAppearance reports whether the group makes faces of its own to give an appearance to: every group that makes a solid does.

HasColor.text: HasColor reports whether the group's colour is the colour of the faces it makes.

HasCombine.text: HasCombine reports whether the group's own combine mode is what joins its solid to the solid so far.

HasDraft.text: HasDraft reports whether the group is an extrusion with a draft.

HasSolidSuppress.text: HasSolidSuppress reports whether leaving the group's solid out of the model is something it does.

IsCopyGroup.text: IsCopyGroup reports whether the group copies its source group, entities and solid, and combines the copies with what came before the source: step and repeat, and mirror.

IsForcedToMesh.text: IsForcedToMesh reports whether the group is built as a triangle mesh instead of a shell: asked to be, an imported mesh, or combined with a mesh.

IsForcedToMeshBySource.text: IsForcedToMeshBySource reports whether the group combines with a group forced to a mesh.

IsLength.text: IsLength reports whether the group's value f is a length, which the interface shows in its unit: a helix's pitch, a chamfer's distances.

IsMeshGroup2.text: IsMeshGroup returns true if this group produces a mesh output (EXTRUDE, LATHE, REVOLVE, HELIX, ROTATE, TRANSLATE).

IsTriangleMeshAssembly.text: IsTriangleMeshAssembly reports whether the group links a triangle mesh, without a shell.

JoinsAssembly.text: JoinsAssembly reports whether the solid so far that g's Boolean joins holds parts put side by side: a group before it combines as an assembly onto a solid made before that.

LoftEnds.text: LoftEnds is how the loft leaves its first profile and reaches its last: ValB and ValC, square to each profile by that much, 0 free (roadmap 28.3).

LoftProfiles.text: LoftProfiles are the groups a loft joins, in order: OpA, LoftThrough and OpB.

LoftTurn.text: LoftTurn is how many curves on the loft joins the second profile's curves turned by, in 0 to the count less one.

MakeLatheCircles.decl: func (g *Group) MakeLatheCircles(sk *Sketch, el *[]core.Entity, in core.HEntity, pt, axis geom.Vector)

MakeLatheSurfacesSelectable.decl: func (g *Group) MakeLatheSurfacesSelectable(sk *Sketch, el *[]core.Entity, in core.HEntity, axis geom.Vector)

MakeRevolveEndFaces.decl: func (g *Group) MakeRevolveEndFaces(sk *Sketch, el *[]core.Entity, pt core.HEntity, ai, af int)
MakeRevolveEndFaces.text: For Revolve and Helix groups the end faces are remapped from an arbitrary point on the sketch.

MakesSolidFromSketch.text: MakesSolidFromSketch reports whether the group makes a solid from the contours of a sketch: an extrusion, lathe, revolve, helix or sweep, or a loft.

PolyProblem.decl: func (g *Group) PolyProblem() (msg string, at geom.Vector, ok bool)
PolyProblem.text: PolyProblem says what is wrong with a sketch's contours, as GenerateLoops found it, and where: an open end, a point off the plane of the rest, where the contour crosses itself, or a curve of no length.

RemapEntity.decl: func (g *Group) RemapEntity(in core.HEntity, copyNumber int) core.HEntity
RemapEntity.text: RemapEntity returns the handle of copy copyNumber of entity in, allocating a new one in the group's remap table if needed.

SetRemapEntry.decl: func (g *Group) SetRemapEntry(input core.HEntity, copyNumber int, id core.EntityID)
SetRemapEntry.text: SetRemapEntry installs an entry in this group's remap table.

SweepSteps.text: SweepSteps are the rigid steps a sweep along lines and arcs moves its profile by, in order from the profile where it is drawn: a line's translation, an arc's turn, and at a mitred corner the turn between two lines, where each is cut by the plane halving the corner (a corner radius is an arc).

Topology.text: Topology is the topology of the solid so far at this group, its running shell, derived on first use after a regeneration: the faces, edges and vertices that edge names refer to.

TransformImportedBy.decl: func (g *Group) TransformImportedBy(sk *Sketch, t geom.Vector, q geom.Quaternion)
TransformImportedBy.text: TransformImportedBy moves a linked group by t and rotates it by q, composing them into its placement parameters.

Value.text: Value returns the field's number and its expression, both addressable.

GroupProblem.text: GroupProblem is a diagnostic on a group: a message and, when the problem has a place, the point it is at.

GroupTiming.text: GroupTiming is what one group took, summed over every regeneration that worked on it, and how many times each step ran.

GroupValue.text: GroupValue names a group value that may hold an expression.

Field.text: Field is the value's name in the file.

Hooks.text: Hooks is what a sketch tells whoever owns it, and asks of them: a user interface implements all of them, NoHooks none, and Messages a function that takes the messages.

Image.text: Image is a loaded image file: its size in pixels, which sets an image request's aspect ratio, and its pixels, for drawing.

Implied.text: Implied is a constraint that a new constraint makes redundant, and that the caller deletes in the same undo step as it adds the new one.

Interference.text: Interference is two parts that overlap: the groups that made them, the volume they share, and its triangles.

MeasureKind.text: MeasureKind is what a measurement is.

MeshQuality.text: MeshQuality names a preset of the mesh export settings: the window, the command line and scripts all pick one by the same table.

String.text: String is the name of q: draft, standard, fine or custom.

Messages.text: Messages is the Hooks of a sketch whose messages go to a function and that asks nothing else.

MoveError.text: MoveError is why a group can't move where it was asked to: Group would come before On, which it refers to through Why.

NoHooks.text: NoHooks is the Hooks of a sketch that nobody watches.

Overlap.text: Overlap is what lies where a point is, so that one of them can be chosen where a click on the drawing picks only one.

Parameter.text: Parameter is a named value that expressions can use.

Generate.text: Generate adds the entities and params of the request.

Runtime.text: Runtime provides quick handle-based lookup for a Sketch.

Constraint.text: Constraint retrieves a constraint by handle.

DistanceValue.text: DistanceValue returns numeric distance for distance entity types.

Entity.text: Entity retrieves an entity by handle.

FontList.text: StyleForEntity is the style entity h draws in; part of the EntityBezierResolver interface.

Group.text: Group retrieves a group by handle.

Normal.text: Normal is an alias for NormalQuaternion that satisfies the EntityBezierResolver interface.

NormalQuaternion.text: NormalQuaternion returns the unit quaternion orientation for the entity referenced by h.

Param.text: Param retrieves a parameter by handle, reading the sketch live.

ParamValue.text: ParamValue implements core.NumericalResolver, returning the numeric value for the supplied parameter handle.

Point.text: Point is an alias for PointValue that satisfies the EntityBezierResolver interface.

PointValue.text: PointValue returns the numeric location for the entity referenced by h.

Radius.text: Radius returns the radius of a circle/arc entity.

Rebuild.text: Rebuild refreshes all handle indexes after the sketch mutates.

RecalculateEntities.text: RecalculateEntities caches every entity's numeric state in its Act* fields (Entity::CalculateNumerical).

Request.text: Request retrieves a request by handle.

Style.text: Style retrieves a style by handle.

Section.text: Section is the section view (an extension): the solid is drawn cut by a plane, the part on the side the plane's normal points to taken away and the cut capped.

Selection.text: Selection is a selected entity or constraint.

ShellJob.text: ShellJob is a regeneration of a copy of the sketch.

Cancel.text: Cancel asks Run to stop at the next group.

Run.text: Run regenerates the copy in full; it may run on any goroutine.

ActivateConfiguration.text: ActivateConfiguration makes the configuration called name active, writing its expressions into the table, or with "" none; the table stays as it is then.

ActivateSurvivor.text: ActivateSurvivor makes the right group active after a change that deleted groups, as deleting one deletes what used it: was, the group that was active before, if it is still there; else, of order, the history before the change, the nearest group before was that is left and isn't the references, so that new groups still come where the history ends.

ActiveGroup.text: ActiveGroup is the active group: Active if it exists, else the one made active after loading a file: the last group, or the first that isn't the references.

ActiveWorkplane.text: ActiveWorkplane is the active group's workplane.

AddConfiguration.text: AddConfiguration adds a configuration of the table's expressions as they are, and makes it active.

AddConstraintRemember.text: AddConstraintRemember adds c with a new handle, and its params, and marks its group dirty.

AddConstraints.text: AddConstraints adds cs, and returns the handle of each: the one made, or the one the sketch had already when it has an equal constraint, which is then not added twice.

AddGroupAfterActive.text: AddGroupAfterActive adds g right after the active group, moving the later groups down, and gives a group that makes a solid the colour of the solid so far.

AddParameter.text: AddParameter adds a parameter at the end of the table.

AddReferences.text: AddReferences adds the references group and its three coordinate plane workplanes, which every sketch has.

AddRequestOfType.decl: func (sk *Sketch) AddRequestOfType(typ RequestType, rememberForUndo bool) core.HRequest
AddRequestOfType.text: AddRequestOfType adds a request of the given type in the active group and workplane, and generates its entities and params, without solving.

AddSplinePoint.decl: func (sk *Sketch) AddSplinePoint(he core.HEntity, after int, at geom.Vector) error
AddSplinePoint.text: AddSplinePoint adds a point at at to the cubic spline that entity he belongs to, after its point number after, which for an open spline is one of the points between its ends' control points or the first of those.

AddThread.decl: func (sk *Sketch) AddThread(he core.HEntity, o ThreadOptions) (ThreadResult, error)
AddThread.text: AddThread makes a screw thread on the circle or arc he, along its normal, after the active group: a sketch and a lathe group that turn the part down to the root of the thread (or bore it out, for an internal thread), then a sketch of the ridge and a helix group that sweeps it.

AddedPending.text: AddedPending is the group ScheduleAdded scheduled whose regeneration has not run yet, or zero.

AlignSameOrientation.text: AlignSameOrientation turns the normal of a same-orientation constraint that the active group can move onto the one it can't, as near as the constraint allows, so that the solver starts at the answer instead of finding a quarter turn of its own.

AnyShellsStale.text: AnyShellsStale reports whether a group's solid is out of date.

AppearanceOf.text: AppearanceOf is the appearance of the face id of the model: its own, or its group's, or "" for the default.

Apply.text: Apply moves the job's groups, with their solids, into the sketch if it is still defined as when the job was made and the job ran to the end, and reports whether it did.

ApplySuggestion.text: ApplySuggestion adds the suggested constraint to the active group, unless it would be redundant; it returns the constraint, or none.

AssemblyParts.text: AssemblyParts are the parts of the model up to group upTo, as the interference check takes them (interference.go): the solid before the first group that combines as an assembly, and each such group.

BillOfMaterials.text: BillOfMaterials is the model's parts, by file, in the order of the first group that places each.

BillOfMaterialsAsRead.text: BillOfMaterialsAsRead is BillOfMaterials for a sketch read from a file and not regenerated, as a linked model's is when the bill of the model linking it counts what it places: which groups are left out is worked out first.

BumpOrderAfterActive.text: BumpOrderAfterActive gives g the order after the active group's and moves the groups after that one down.

CalculateEntityBBox.text: CalculateEntityBBox returns the bounding box of the non-construction entities.

CenterOfMass.text: CenterOfMass is the centre of mass of the solid at group hg, taken as of one density throughout.

CheckMoveGroup.text: CheckMoveGroup reports the error MoveGroup(h, before) would give, without moving anything.

CheckMoveGroupWithSources.text: CheckMoveGroupWithSources reports the error MoveGroupWithSources would give, without moving anything.

CheckThread.decl: func (sk *Sketch) CheckThread(he core.HEntity, o ThreadOptions) error
CheckThread.text: CheckThread reports why AddThread would refuse to make the thread, without changing anything.

ChordTolPercent.text: ChordTolPercent is the chord tolerance in effect, as a percentage of the model's size.

ClearBrokenReferences.text: ClearBrokenReferences empties the list of what regenerations deleted.

ClearExisting.text: ClearExisting drops the whole sketch and the undo history, leaving it without even the references; the caller must fix that.

ClearSection.text: ClearSection turns the section view off.

CommentConstraint.decl: func (sk *Sketch) CommentConstraint(base core.Constraint, pt core.HEntity, text string) (core.Constraint, error)
CommentConstraint.text: CommentConstraint makes a comment with the given text, attached to the point pt when that is not NoEntity, as a copy of base.

Configuration.text: Configuration is the configuration called name, or nil.

Constrain.decl: func (sk *Sketch) Constrain(typ core.ConstraintType, ptA, ptB, entityA, entityB core.HEntity, other, other2 bool) core.HConstraint
Constrain.text: Constrain adds a constraint of the given type in the active group and workplane.

ConstrainArcLineTangent.decl: func (sk *Sketch) ConstrainArcLineTangent(c *core.Constraint, line, arc, arcEndpoint *core.Entity) error
ConstrainArcLineTangent.text: ConstrainArcLineTangent sets which end of arc c makes tangent to line: the one they share, else arcEndpoint.

ConstrainCoincident.text: ConstrainCoincident makes points ptA and ptB coincident.

ConstrainCubicLineTangent.decl: func (sk *Sketch) ConstrainCubicLineTangent(c *core.Constraint, line, cubic, curveEndpoint *core.Entity) error
ConstrainCubicLineTangent.text: ConstrainCubicLineTangent sets which end of cubic c makes tangent to line.

ConstrainCurveCurveTangent.decl: func (sk *Sketch) ConstrainCurveCurveTangent(c *core.Constraint, eA, eB, epA, epB *core.Entity) error
ConstrainCurveCurveTangent.text: ConstrainCurveCurveTangent sets at which ends c makes curves eA and eB tangent: the ends they share, else epA and epB.

CopySelection.text: CopySelection copies the selected entities that requests generate (not workplanes), the selected comments, and the constraints among the copied entities.

CreateAllDefaultStyles.text: CreateAllDefaultStyles makes sure the sketch has every default style.

CreateDefaultDrawingGroup.text: CreateDefaultDrawingGroup adds the empty group in the XY plane that a new file starts in.

CreateDefaultStyle.text: CreateDefaultStyle adds style h: the default style it names, or else a custom one like the active group's.

CreateParam.decl: func (sk *Sketch) CreateParam(h core.HParam, val float64) core.HParam
CreateParam.text: CreateParam adds a new parameter to the sketch.

DeleteAllConstraintsFor.decl: func (sk *Sketch) DeleteAllConstraintsFor(typ core.ConstraintType, entityA, ptA core.HEntity)
DeleteAllConstraintsFor.text: DeleteAllConstraintsFor deletes the constraints of the given type on entityA and ptA; used when auto-removing constraints that would become redundant.

DeleteConfiguration.text: DeleteConfiguration removes a configuration; the table stays as it is.

DeleteImplied.text: DeleteImplied deletes the constraints imp names.

DeletePointCoincidences.text: DeletePointCoincidences deletes the constraints that make point hp coincident with others, and reports an error when there are none.

DeleteSelection.text: DeleteSelection deletes the selected requests (not the references) and constraints.

DeleteTaggedRequests.text: DeleteTaggedRequests deletes the tagged requests, fixing up the point-coincident constraints on their points, and regenerates.

DependenciesOf.text: DependenciesOf is GroupDependencies of g, which need not be in the sketch yet: a group about to be added has no requests or constraints.

DistanceLabelOffset.text: DistanceLabelOffset is where the label of a new distance between points at a and b goes, as Constrain > Distance puts it: 50 pixels from the middle, across the line between them in the view.

EntitiesToMap.text: EntitiesToMap returns the entities indexed by their handle.

EntityAfter.decl: func (sk *Sketch) EntityAfter(he core.HEntity, h core.HGroup) (core.HGroup, bool)
EntityAfter.text: EntityAfter reports whether entity he belongs to a group after group h in the history, which h may not refer to; it gives that group.

EntityFreedom.text: EntityFreedom is how much of entity he its group's constraints fix: whether all, some or none of the params it is made of, and that its group solves for, can move.

EntityIsVisible.text: EntityIsVisible reports whether the entity is drawn, by the show flags of sk.Show (the defaults when nil).

EntityName.text: entityName names entity he, which may have been deleted since the last regeneration, by its request or its group.

EqualConstraints.text: EqualConstraints makes the constraints that Constrain > Equal Length / Radius makes of the entities es, whatever order they come in, each a copy of base with its type and entities set.

EvaluateParameters.text: EvaluateParameters evaluates the parameter table, then every stored expression, and writes the numbers into the values they drive.

ExportMeshTo.decl: func (sk *Sketch) ExportMeshTo(filename string, es ExportSettings) error
ExportMeshTo.text: ExportMeshTo writes the active group's mesh, regenerated at the export chord tolerance, to filename; the extension picks the format, STL or 3MF.

FaceEdges.text: FaceEdges are the edges of the solid at the active group that bound any of faces, where the face meets another: what the menu's Select Face Edges and a script's SolidFace.SelectEdges select.

FaceName.text: FaceName names a face of a solid by its identity: the entity that made it, or for a face no entity names, the group that made it.

FacesArea.text: FacesArea is the area of the faces of group hg's solid that the face entities hs stand for.

FixConstraintsForPointBeingDeleted.text: FixConstraintsForPointBeingDeleted deletes the point-coincident constraints on hpt, and makes the points they joined to it coincident with each other.

FixConstraintsForRequestBeingDeleted.text: FixConstraintsForRequestBeingDeleted keeps the points made coincident through a point of request hr, which is being deleted, coincident.

FontFiles.text: FontFiles is the basenames of the font files a text can be set in, as the text window lists them.

ForceReferences.text: ForceReferences forces the values of the params that define the three reference coordinate systems.

FreezeDefaultStyles.text: FreezeDefaultStyles saves the default styles as the user's settings, with widths and text heights at the view's scale.

GenerateAdded.text: GenerateAdded regenerates after group hg was added: hg and the groups after it, which may refer to what it makes, and the sketches it makes a solid of, which say what is wrong with them as a profile only once something is made of them.

GenerateAll.text: GenerateAll regenerates the whole model: every group's entities and params, then the solve, loops and shells.

GenerateAllFindFree.text: GenerateAllFindFree regenerates like GenerateAllTyped and also works out which parameters are free, for Analyze > Show Degrees of Freedom.

GenerateAllTyped.text: GenerateAllTyped is GenerateAll with a GenerateType.

GroupDependencies.text: GroupDependencies lists the groups group h refers to, each once, in history order: through its operand, its workplane and predefined entities, the entities its requests and constraints name, and the sources of its copied entities.

GroupDependents.text: GroupDependents lists the groups that refer to group h directly, in history order.

GroupFreedom.text: GroupFreedom reports which of the params group hg solves for are free to move, at the values of the last regeneration; nil when the group did not solve or is too large.

GroupName.text: anyGroupName names group h, which may have been deleted since the last regeneration.

GroupNamed.text: GroupNamed is the group with a name, or with a description as the property browser shows it: "g003-extrude", or just "g003"; nil when there is none.

GroupsInOrder.text: groupsInOrder reports whether before comes before after.

Interferences.text: Interferences checks the parts of the model up to group upTo against each other.

Length.text: Length is the total length of the curves of entities hs: line segments, arcs, circles, cubics and text.

LoadFactoryDefaults.text: LoadFactoryDefaults resets the default styles to their factory settings.

LockedInWorkplane.text: LockedInWorkplane is whether the active group sketches in a workplane.

MakeSplinePeriodic.text: MakeSplinePeriodic closes the open cubic spline that entity he belongs to into a periodic one: its two ends become one, and the control points beside them are let go of, which the window does when a click lands on the spline's first point again while a point is being placed.

MakeTangentArc.decl: func (sk *Sketch) MakeTangentArc(hpt core.HEntity, settings TangentArcSettings) error
MakeTangentArc.text: MakeTangentArc rounds the corner at point hpt, where two non-construction line segments or arcs join, with a tangent arc.

MarkGroupDirty.text: MarkGroupDirty marks group hg, and unless onlyThis every group after it, as needing regeneration, and schedules it.

MarkGroupDirtyByEntity.text: MarkGroupDirtyByEntity marks the group of entity he dirty.

Measure.text: Measure measures entities, as the description of the selection does: one line segment or circle; two points; a point and a circle, line segment or plane face; two lines, normals or plane faces; or two points and a line along which to project their distance.

MeshProblems.decl: func (sk *Sketch) MeshProblems() (naked srf.SEdgeList, inters, leaks bool)
MeshProblems.text: MeshProblems measures the active group's display mesh: its naked and self-intersecting edges, whether it crosses itself and whether it leaks (has naked edges).

MidpointConstraint.decl: func (sk *Sketch) MidpointConstraint(base core.Constraint, line, point core.HEntity) (core.Constraint, []Implied, error)
MidpointConstraint.text: MidpointConstraint makes the constraint that puts the middle of the line segment line at point, which may be a point or a workplane (the middle then lies in the plane), as a copy of base.

MirrorPlaneOK.text: MirrorPlaneOK reports whether he can be the plane of a mirror: a workplane or a planar face.

MovablePoints.text: MovablePoints are the points that moving entity he moves: the point itself, or a curve's, a text's or an image's points; none for what has no points of its own to move, as a normal or a workplane.

MoveGroup.text: MoveGroup moves group h to just before group before in the history, or to the end for the zero handle.

MoveGroupWithSources.text: MoveGroupWithSources moves group h, with its OwnSources in their order, to just before group before, or to the end for the zero handle, as MoveGroup moves one group: a move that would put a group ahead of one it refers to is refused with a *MoveError, and nothing moves.

MovePointsBy.text: MovePointsBy moves each point by d, as a drag would put it, and marks their groups to be solved again; a point named twice moves once.

MustEntity.text: MustEntity is GetEntity for handles that must exist.

MustParam.text: MustParam is GetParam for handles that must exist.

NamedConstraint.text: NamedConstraint is the constraint named name, or nil.

NearestSplineSpan.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NearestSplineSpan(he core.HEntity, at geom.Vector) (int, error)
NearestSplineSpan.text: NearestSplineSpan is the point of the spline of entity he that a point added nearest at should follow: the start of the span between two neighbouring points, of those AddSplinePoint takes, that passes nearest at.

NewChamfer.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewChamfer(edges []core.HEntity, solidEdges []topo.Name, distance float64, name string) (Group, error)
NewChamfer.text: NewChamfer starts a chamfer at the active group, of edges of the solid so far: line segments along edges between two planar faces, and edges of the solid itself, by name, straight and between two planar faces; at distance mm from each edge on both faces.

NewCustomStyle.text: NewCustomStyle adds a custom style, numbered after the last, with the defaults, and returns its handle.

NewFile.text: NewFile makes the sketch a new, empty file: the references group with the three reference workplanes, and a drawing group.

NewFillet.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewFillet(edges []core.HEntity, solidEdges []topo.Name, radius float64, name string) (Group, error)
NewFillet.text: NewFillet starts a fillet at the active group, of edges of the solid so far, given as line segment entities or by name, with radius mm.

NewLoft.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewLoft(from, to core.HGroup, name string) (Group, error)
NewLoft.text: NewLoft starts a loft from the profile of group from to that of group to, both sketches in workplanes with one closed loop.

NewMirror.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewMirror(plane core.HEntity, name string) (Group, error)
NewMirror.text: NewMirror starts a mirror group that reflects the active group in plane, a workplane or a planar face.

NewPathPattern.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewPathPattern(path []core.HEntity, copies int, name string) (Group, error)
NewPathPattern.text: NewPathPattern starts a pattern of the active group's solid along path, line segments and arcs joined end to end and meeting tangent, copies times in all.

NewShell.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewShell(faces []srf.FaceID, thick float64, name string) (Group, error)
NewShell.text: NewShell starts a shell at the active group, hollowing the solid so far to walls thick mm, open at faces.

NewShellJob.text: NewShellJob copies what defines the sketch, for a job to regenerate.

NewSketchOnFace.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewSketchOnFace(face srf.FaceID, name string) (Group, error)
NewSketchOnFace.text: NewSketchOnFace starts a sketch whose workplane lies in the flat face face of the solid at the active group, its normal out of the solid.

NewSketchOnLines.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewSketchOnLines(origin, lineA, lineB core.HEntity, right, up geom.Vector, name string) (Group, error)
NewSketchOnLines.text: NewSketchOnLines starts a sketch in the workplane through the point origin, parallel to the line segments lineA and lineB, which follows them when they move.

NewSketchOnNormal.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewSketchOnNormal(origin, normal core.HEntity, name string) (Group, error)
NewSketchOnNormal.text: NewSketchOnNormal starts a sketch in the workplane through the point origin, square to a normal, which it follows.

NewSmoothLoft.text: NewSmoothLoft starts a loft through the profiles of groups, two or more, in order: two make a ruled loft, more a smooth one.

NewSweep.text: NewSweep starts a sweep of the active group's sketch along path, line segments and arcs joined end to end and meeting tangent.

NewSweepAlong.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewSweepAlong(path []core.HEntity, solidEdges []topo.Name, name string) (Group, error)
NewSweepAlong.text: NewSweepAlong is NewSweep along path and edges of the solid so far, by name, together one chain (roadmap 28.4): straight and circular edges, and curved ones as cubics are.

NormalOf.text: NormalOf is the normal entity that he stands for: he itself when it is a normal, the normal of a workplane, a circle or an arc otherwise.

OrientNormal.decl: func (sk *Sketch) OrientNormal(he core.HEntity, q geom.Quaternion) error
OrientNormal.text: OrientNormal turns the normal of he (see NormalOf) to q and marks its group to be solved again, as dragging the normal in the window does; the solver then moves it as the constraints require.

OutwardFaceNormal.text: OutwardFaceNormal is a face's normal, turned to point out of the solid, as its triangles' do.

Overlap.text: Overlap lists what is drawn where point he is, in the order of the entities: what a click there could have picked.

OwnSources.text: OwnSources is group h with the groups only it needs: those it refers to, directly or through each other, that no group outside them uses, as an extrusion's sketch and that sketch's own workplane.

ParallelConstraint.decl: func (sk *Sketch) ParallelConstraint(base core.Constraint, a, b core.HEntity) (core.Constraint, error)
ParallelConstraint.text: ParallelConstraint makes the constraint that makes a and b parallel, as a copy of base: two line segments or normals in any mix, or two faces.

Parameter.text: Parameter returns the parameter named name, or nil.

ParameterUsers.text: ParameterUsers describes what names the parameter: other parameters, constraints and group values.

ParamsToMap.text: ParamsToMap returns the current param values as a map from handle to float64.

PasteClipboard.decl: func (sk *Sketch) PasteClipboard(trans geom.Vector, theta, scale float64) []Selection
PasteClipboard.text: PasteClipboard pastes the clipboard into the active group and workplane: scaled (mirrored if negative) in the workplane, rotated by theta about its normal, and moved by trans.

PerpendicularConstraint.decl: func (sk *Sketch) PerpendicularConstraint(base core.Constraint, a, b core.HEntity) (core.Constraint, error)
PerpendicularConstraint.text: PerpendicularConstraint makes the constraint that makes a and b perpendicular, as a copy of base: two line segments or normals in any mix, or two faces.

PointIsCoincident.text: PointIsCoincident reports whether a constraint makes point hp coincident with another.

PopOntoCurrentFrom.text: PopOntoCurrentFrom makes the last state on uk the current one, then reloads the linked files and regenerates.

ProjectPoint.text: ProjectPoint projects p to the screen in the sketch's view.

PruneGroups.text: PruneGroups removes group hg if its operand or predef entities don't exist (yet), and reports whether it did.

PruneOrphans.text: PruneOrphans removes requests and constraints whose group doesn't exist.

PruneRequestsAndConstraints.text: PruneRequestsAndConstraints removes group hg's requests and constraints that refer to entities that don't exist.

PushFromCurrentOnto.text: PushFromCurrentOnto records the current state on uk, over its oldest one when it's full.

RegenerationPending.text: RegenerationPending reports whether a regeneration is scheduled and hasn't run, so that what is read from the sketch may be stale.

RegionArea.text: RegionArea is the area of the closed region group hg's sketch draws, holes taken out.

RemakeStaleMeshes.text: RemakeStaleMeshes makes every group's solid again when one was made at another chord tolerance than the sketch's: a regeneration of the groups after it changed the model's size, and so the tolerance, and left the solid as it was.

RemoveConstraintsForPointBeingDeleted.text: RemoveConstraintsForPointBeingDeleted deletes the constraints on hpt.

RemoveSplinePoint.text: RemoveSplinePoint takes point hp out of the cubic spline it belongs to.

RenameParameter.text: RenameParameter renames a parameter and every use of it, in other parameters, in constraints and in groups.

ReplacePointInConstraints.text: ReplacePointInConstraints moves the constraints on oldpt to newpt.

SameChamferDistances.text: SameChamferDistances makes the second distance of chamfer h its first again.

ScheduleAdded.text: ScheduleAdded is GenerateAdded when Refresh next runs: what was added can then be changed, as a script sets the combine mode of a solid it has just made, before anything is made of it.

ScheduleGenerateAll.text: ScheduleGenerateAll asks for a regeneration of the dirty groups when Refresh next runs.

SectionCut.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SectionCut() (keep srf.HalfSpace, origin geom.Vector, ok bool, err error)
SectionCut.text: SectionCut is where the section view cuts now: the half space it keeps, and a point on its plane.

SectionPlaneName.text: SectionPlaneName names the section's plane for the user: a workplane by its request or group, a face by its group.

SeedParam.text: SeedParam sets param h to v, adding it if the group it belongs to has not been generated yet: the next regeneration takes v as where the param's solve starts, as it does a value from the regeneration before.

SegmentLimit.text: SegmentLimit is MaxSegments, or its default.

SetChamferSecondDistance.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetChamferSecondDistance(h core.HGroup, mm float64) error
SetChamferSecondDistance.text: SetChamferSecondDistance makes chamfer h one of two distances: ValB on each edge's first face and mm on the second; 0 makes it of one distance again.

SetConstraintLabelOffset.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetConstraintLabelOffset(hc core.HConstraint, off geom.Vector) error
SetConstraintLabelOffset.text: SetConstraintLabelOffset puts the label of a dimension or a comment at off from the place the constraint measures: what dragging the label does, on every move of the mouse.

SetConstraintName.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetConstraintName(hc core.HConstraint, name string) error
SetConstraintName.text: SetConstraintName names the constraint hc, renaming every use of an old name, or with "" takes its name away, which a name in use can't be.

SetConstraintShowAsRadius.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetConstraintShowAsRadius(hc core.HConstraint, radius bool) error
SetConstraintShowAsRadius.text: SetConstraintShowAsRadius makes a diameter dimension show as a radius, or as a diameter again.

SetConstraintText.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetConstraintText(hc core.HConstraint, text string) error
SetConstraintText.text: SetConstraintText gives a constraint the value of what the user typed for its label, a length in the document's unit (Units).

SetDraftFaces.text: SetDraftFaces makes the extrusion hg's draft lean the sides of the curves es of its sketch only, or every side when es is empty.

SetEdgeRadiusText.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetEdgeRadiusText(hg core.HGroup, i int, text string) error
SetEdgeRadiusText.text: SetEdgeRadiusText gives a fillet's edge i a radius of its own from what the user typed, in the document's unit, as SetGroupText does for the group's radius; "" gives it the group's radius again.

SetFaceAppearance.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetFaceAppearance(id srf.FaceID, name string) error
SetFaceAppearance.text: SetFaceAppearance gives the face id of the model an appearance of its own, or with "" takes it away, so that it has its group's again.

SetGroupAppearance.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetGroupAppearance(hg core.HGroup, name string) error
SetGroupAppearance.text: SetGroupAppearance gives the group's solid an appearance by name, "" for the default.

SetGroupColor.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetGroupColor(hg core.HGroup, c core.RGBA) error
SetGroupColor.text: SetGroupColor colours the group's solid with the red, green and blue of c, keeping its opacity.

SetGroupCombine.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetGroupCombine(hg core.HGroup, as CombineAs, flip bool) error
SetGroupCombine.text: SetGroupCombine sets how a group's solid combines with the solid so far.

SetGroupCopies.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetGroupCopies(hg core.HGroup, text string, respace bool) error
SetGroupCopies.text: SetGroupCopies sets a step and repeat or pattern group's number of copies from typed text, as SetGroupText does for GroupCopies.

SetGroupLinkAsSolid.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetGroupLinkAsSolid(hg core.HGroup, on bool) error
SetGroupLinkAsSolid.text: SetGroupLinkAsSolid has a linked STEP file read as a solid (on) or as a reference mesh, and reads the file again.

SetGroupOpacity.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetGroupOpacity(hg core.HGroup, alpha float64) error
SetGroupOpacity.text: SetGroupOpacity sets how opaque the group's solid is, from 0 to 1, leaving its colour.

SetGroupSkewed.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetGroupSkewed(hg core.HGroup, skewed bool) error
SetGroupSkewed.text: SetGroupSkewed makes an extrusion's sides lean with its sketch (skewed) or stand straight, in either its one-sided or two-sided mode.

SetGroupSkipFirst.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetGroupSkipFirst(hg core.HGroup, skip bool) error
SetGroupSkipFirst.text: SetGroupSkipFirst has a one-sided step and repeat start with its first copy (skip) rather than the original; for a mirror it leaves the original out of the solid, so that only the reflection is left.

SetGroupSuppressSolid.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetGroupSuppressSolid(hg core.HGroup, on bool) error
SetGroupSuppressSolid.text: SetGroupSuppressSolid leaves the group's solid out of the model, or puts it back, keeping the group's sketch and solve.

SetGroupText.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetGroupText(hg core.HGroup, f GroupValue, text string) error
SetGroupText.text: SetGroupText gives a group value what the user typed, as SetConstraintText does for a constraint: a pitch is in the document's unit.

SetLoftGuides.text: SetLoftGuides makes the line segments, arcs and cubics es the guide curves of the loft hg, or takes its guides away when es is empty.

SetParameterExpr.text: SetParameterExpr gives a parameter a new expression.

SetSection.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetSection(plane core.HEntity, offset string, flip bool) error
SetSection.text: SetSection turns the section view on, cutting parallel to plane, a workplane or a planar face, offset (typed, in the document's unit; "" is zero) along its normal, away from the side flip picks.

SetStyleTextHeightUnits.text: SetStyleTextHeightUnits measures style h's text height in as, keeping the height it is drawn at on the screen: the number is converted at the view's scale, so a switch of units changes what the style says and not how big its text looks.

SetStyleTextHorizontal.text: SetStyleTextHorizontal aligns style h's text on the left of its anchor (core.TextOriginLeft), on the right (core.TextOriginRight) or centred (core.TextOriginNone), leaving the vertical alignment as it is.

SetStyleTextVertical.text: SetStyleTextVertical aligns style h's text on the bottom of its anchor (core.TextOriginBot), on the top (core.TextOriginTop) or centred (core.TextOriginNone), leaving the horizontal alignment as it is.

SetSuppressAll.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetSuppressAll(h core.HGroup, on bool) error
SetSuppressAll.text: SetSuppressAll suppresses group h whole, or brings it back, and has the model regenerated.

SetSweepUp.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetSweepUp(hg core.HGroup, up geom.Vector) error
SetSweepUp.text: SetSweepUp holds a sweep's frames to the direction up, made a unit vector, or lets them turn least when up is zero.

SetTextFont.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetTextFont(hr core.HRequest, font string) error
SetTextFont.text: SetTextFont changes the font of a text request to the font file whose basename is font.

SetTextKerning.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetTextKerning(hr core.HRequest, kerning bool) error
SetTextKerning.text: SetTextKerning turns the kerning of a text request on or off.

SetTextString.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetTextString(hr core.HRequest, s string) error
SetTextString.text: SetTextString changes the string of a text request.

SetUnits.text: SetUnits makes u the document's unit, keeping every size: a plain value is a number of millimetres and does not change, and a stored expression of a length is rewritten to give the same length in u, "(1/4)*25.4" from "1/4" in inches to millimetres, or back again without the factor.

SettingsStore.text: SettingsStore is Settings, or a store that keeps nothing.

SettleConstraint.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SettleConstraint(hc core.HConstraint) (existing core.HConstraint, duplicate bool)
SettleConstraint.text: SettleConstraint finishes a constraint hc that was just added.

ShowNakedEdges.text: ShowNakedEdges finds the active group's naked and self-intersecting edges, and reports them through Message; with reportOnlyWhenNotOkay, only if there are any.

ShownValue.text: ShownValue is the value of a constraint as its label shows it, in the document's unit, which an expression reads by its name.

SolidAt.text: SolidAt is the group whose running solid is the model at group hg, or nil when there is none: the solid whose edges a chamfer there cuts and the interface lets the user pick.

SolidEdgeName.text: SolidEdgeName names an edge of a solid for a person: the faces it lies between.

SolveGroupAndReport.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SolveGroupAndReport(hg core.HGroup, groupParams []core.HParam, andFindFree bool)
SolveGroupAndReport.text: SolveGroupAndReport solves group hg for groupParams, the params its requests, constraints and the group itself generate, holding every other param fixed.

SplitLinesOrCurves.text: SplitLinesOrCurves splits the selected entities where they intersect: two lines, circles, arcs or cubics, or one of them and a point on it.

StyleColor.decl: func (sk *Sketch) StyleColor(h core.HStyle, forExport, fixExportColors bool) core.RGBA
StyleColor.text: StyleColor is style h's stroke colour, rewritten for export as RewriteColor says.

StyleExportable.text: StyleExportable reports whether lines of style h go in exported files: if it's both shown and exportable.

StyleFillColor.decl: func (sk *Sketch) StyleFillColor(h core.HStyle, forExport, fixExportColors bool) core.RGBA
StyleFillColor.text: StyleFillColor is style h's fill colour.

StyleForEntity.text: StyleForEntity is the style entity he draws in: its own, else by whether it's in the active group, or construction.

StyleGet.text: StyleGet is style h, created with default settings if the sketch doesn't have it yet; no style means the active group's.

StylePatternType.text: StylePatternType is style h's stipple pattern.

StyleStippleScale.text: StyleStippleScale is style h's stipple scale.

StyleTextHeight.decl: func (sk *Sketch) StyleTextHeight(h core.HStyle, scale float64) float64
StyleTextHeight.text: StyleTextHeight is style h's text height in pixels.

StyleView.text: StyleView is style h as it would be drawn, without changing the sketch: the style itself when the sketch has it, else a copy of the default it would be made as, and nil for a handle that is neither.

StyleWidth.decl: func (sk *Sketch) StyleWidth(h core.HStyle, scale float64) float64
StyleWidth.text: StyleWidth is style h's width in pixels, at the view's scale in pixels per mm.

SuggestConstraint.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SuggestConstraint(request core.HRequest, wp core.HEntity, group core.HGroup) (Suggestion, bool)
SuggestConstraint.text: SuggestConstraint suggests a constraint for the entity of request as it is drawn in workplane wp and group, when it nearly meets one; none in 3d, where nothing is drawn locked to a plane, but for circles.

SuppressedReason.text: SuppressedReason says why group h is left out of the model, or "" if it is generated: "suppressed", or "uses g003-extrude, which is suppressed".

SwapChamferDistances.text: SwapChamferDistances swaps the two distances of chamfer h, which chamfers each edge the other way round.

SymmetricConstraint.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SymmetricConstraint(base core.Constraint, a, b, about core.HEntity) (core.Constraint, []Implied, error)
SymmetricConstraint.text: SymmetricConstraint makes the constraint that makes two points symmetric, as a copy of base: a and b are the points, or a is a line segment and b is NoEntity, and its two ends are the points.

TangentConstraint.decl: func (sk *Sketch) TangentConstraint(base core.Constraint, a, b core.HEntity, ends ...core.HEntity) (core.Constraint, error)
TangentConstraint.text: TangentConstraint makes the constraint that makes a and b tangent, as a copy of base: an arc or a cubic with a line segment (in either order), or an arc or a cubic with another, in the workplane of base.

Tell.text: Tell shows the user a message, through the sketch's Hooks.

TestRankForGroup.text: TestRankForGroup reports whether group hg would be redundantly constrained, and its rank; a group that allows redundancy or doesn't count its freedom is okay with rank 0.

Tol.text: Tol is the tolerance the last regeneration followed curves and surfaces at: the export one while Exporting is set, otherwise one from the model's size and ChordTolPct.

TryConstrain.decl: func (sk *Sketch) TryConstrain(typ core.ConstraintType, ptA, ptB, entityA, entityB core.HEntity, other, other2 bool) core.HConstraint
TryConstrain.text: TryConstrain is Constrain, except that a constraint that would be redundant isn't added; it then returns no constraint.

TurnAxis.decl: func (sk *Sketch) TurnAxis(point, vector core.HEntity) (origin, dir core.HEntity, err error)
TurnAxis.text: TurnAxis is the point and the direction a lathe, a revolve or a helix turns about: the point and a vector (a line segment or a normal), the axis through the point parallel to it; or, with no point (a zero handle), a line segment, the axis along it from its first end.

UndoClearStack.text: UndoClearStack forgets every state on uk.

UndoDropNewest.text: UndoDropNewest forgets the n states remembered last for undo, leaving the sketch as it is: what they would take back joins the step remembered before them.

UndoPushedSince.text: UndoPushedSince is how many states were remembered for undo since the stack's write position was write, for a change that remembers its own steps; 0 when the position went back, as an undo moves it.

UndoRedo.text: UndoRedo restores the last undone state.

UndoRemember.text: UndoRemember records the current state for undo, and forgets what could be redone.

UndoRememberFor.text: UndoRememberFor records the current state for undo, as UndoRemember does, and then runs fn to change it.

UndoUndo.text: UndoUndo restores the last remembered state, keeping the current one for redo; false if there is none.

UpgradeLegacyData.text: UpgradeLegacyData brings a freshly loaded sketch up to date, and regenerates its entities without solving.

WriteEquationsExceptFor.decl: func (sk *Sketch) WriteEquationsExceptFor(hg core.HGroup, hc core.HConstraint, l *[]core.Equation)
WriteEquationsExceptFor.text: WriteEquationsExceptFor appends the equations of group hg: those of its constraints except hc, of its entities, and of the group itself.

SketchDiagnostic.text: SketchDiagnostic captures transient per-group errors during Sketch::GenerateAll.

Suggestion.text: Suggestion is a constraint an entity being drawn would get when it is placed (roadmap 16.11 for lines, 29.4 for arcs and circles): its type, its entities, and which ends of curves it takes.

TangentArcSettings.text: TangentArcSettings are the user's settings for MakeTangentArc.

ThreadOptions.text: ThreadOptions is a screw thread to make on a circle.

Timings.text: Timings collects how long regenerations spend on each group: solving it, making its loops and building its solid.

Groups.text: Groups are the groups' figures, in the order they were first timed.

UndoStack.text: UndoStack is a ring of up to MaxUndo states.

UndoState.text: UndoState is one snapshot of the sketch: what can't be regenerated.

View.text: View is the map from model space to screen pixels: the window's offset, projection vectors and scale; Tangent is the perspective factor, zero for an orthographic view.

NormalizeProjectionVectors.text: NormalizeProjectionVectors makes ProjRight and ProjUp orthonormal.

ProjectPoint.text: ProjectPoint projects p to screen pixels.

ProjectPoint3.text: ProjectPoint3 projects p to screen pixels, z included.

ProjectPoint4.decl: func (v *View) ProjectPoint4(p geom.Vector) (r geom.Vector, w float64)
ProjectPoint4.text: ProjectPoint4 projects p halfway into screen space: no scale and no perspective divide; w is returned.

UnProjectPoint.text: UnProjectPoint is the point in the plane through the offset, parallel to the screen, that projects onto p.

VectorFromProjs.text: VectorFromProjs is the model-space vector with the given right, up and forward screen components.

Visibility.text: Visibility holds the view's show flags the engine reads: Entity::IsVisible reads the first four, Group::GenerateDisplayItems the last two.

AddParam.decl: func AddParam(param *[]core.Param, hp core.HParam, v float64)
AddParam.text: AddParam appends a group param with an initial value.

AlmostEqualQuaternion.decl: func AlmostEqualQuaternion(a, b geom.Quaternion, tol float64) bool
AlmostEqualQuaternion.text: AlmostEqualQuaternion returns whether two quaternions represent the same rotation.

AlmostEqualVector.decl: func AlmostEqualVector(a, b geom.Vector, tol float64) bool
AlmostEqualVector.text: AlmostEqualVector reports whether two vectors are within tolerance.

ConstraintText.text: ConstraintText is the stored expression of a constraint as its label's editor shows it, the inverse of SetConstraintText: without the sign of a distance on the far side, and as a radius for a diameter shown as one.

ConvertLengthExpr.decl: func ConvertLengthExpr(expr string, fromMm, toMm float64) string
ConvertLengthExpr.text: ConvertLengthExpr rewrites the expression of a length in a unit of fromMm millimetres to give the same length in one of toMm: the factor between them is appended, or taken off when it is the one a conversion the other way appended.

DefaultDrawing.text: DefaultDrawing is the drawing a model starts one with: an A3 sheet, landscape, fitted, third-angle, with hidden edges.

DefaultView.text: DefaultView is the view GraphicsWindow::Init sets up: identity projection at 5 pixels per mm, orthographic.

DefaultVisibility.text: DefaultVisibility is what GraphicsWindow::Init sets: points, normals, construction, edges, reference dimensions and comments shown, workplanes and outlines not.

EdgeRadiusField.text: EdgeRadiusField names an edge's radius in messages and in the file.

EntityPointCount.decl: func EntityPointCount(entity core.EntityType, extraPoints int) (pts int, ok bool)
EntityPointCount.text: EntityPointCount is how many points an entity of that type has; ok is false for a type no request makes.

ExportMeshAs3mfTo.text: ExportMeshAs3mfTo writes m as a 3MF file.

ExportMeshAsStlTo.decl: func ExportMeshAsStlTo(w io.Writer, m *srf.SMesh, scale float64) error
ExportMeshAsStlTo.text: ExportMeshAsStlTo writes m as a binary STL file, in export units of scale mm.

GenerateConstraint.text: GenerateConstraint adds the params the constraint needs.

GenerateEntityBeziers.text: GenerateEntityBeziers populates the supplied SBezierList with the piecewise-rational Bezier representation of this entity.

IsLengthValue.text: IsLengthValue reports whether a constraint's value is a length, which the interface shows in its unit, rather than an angle or a ratio.

Letter.text: Letter is the letter of the n-th section or detail view: A, B, ..., Z, AA, AB, ...

MeshQualitySettings.decl: func MeshQualitySettings(q MeshQuality) (chordMm, angleDeg float64, segments int)
MeshQualitySettings.text: MeshQualitySettings is the chord tolerance in export units, the angular tolerance in degrees and the segment limit of preset q.

MeshSoundnessError.decl: func MeshSoundnessError(naked srf.SEdgeList, inters, leaks bool) error
MeshSoundnessError.text: MeshSoundnessError is nil when a mesh with the given problems (as MeshProblems finds them) may be exported, and an error that wraps ErrMeshNotSound, saying what is wrong, when it may not.

NewGroup.text: NewGroup is a group as the menu starts one: visible, grey, at scale 1.

NewRuntime.text: NewRuntime creates a runtime lookup wrapper for the provided sketch.

ParseExprText.text: ParseExprText parses a string expression and returns an Expr.

ParseMeshQuality.text: ParseMeshQuality is the preset named s, ignoring case.

QualityOf.decl: func QualityOf(chordMm, angleDeg float64, segments int) MeshQuality
QualityOf.text: QualityOf is the preset whose settings are the given ones, or MeshQualityCustom.

ScaleText.text: ScaleText is a scale as a drawing writes it: 1:2, 5:1.

SetConstraintValue.text: SetConstraintValue gives a constraint the value v that the user typed: in millimetres, degrees or a ratio, the magnitude the label shows.

SheetSize.decl: func SheetSize(name string) (w, h float64, ok bool)
SheetSize.text: SheetSize is the size of a sheet in mm, landscape.

SplitNamedText.decl: func SplitNamedText(s string) (name string, named bool, value string)
SplitNamedText.text: SplitNamedText splits what was typed in a dimension's label: "name = value" names it, "= value" takes its name away, and a value alone leaves the name as it is (named false).

ThawExportSettings.text: ThawExportSettings reads the export settings, with their defaults.

ViewDirection.decl: func ViewDirection(kind string) (right, up [3]float64, ok bool)
ViewDirection.text: ViewDirection is what is to the right and what is up in a view.

WriteBOMCSV.text: WriteBOMCSV writes the bill of materials as CSV: a header, then a line for each part with its count, its file and the groups that place it.

DimensionKinds.text: DimensionKinds are the kinds of drawing dimension and how many edges each takes.

ErrConstraintSelection.text: ErrConstraintSelection is wrapped by the errors of the builders in this file for entities that the constraint does not take.

ErrEqualSelection.text: ErrEqualSelection is wrapped by the error EqualConstraints returns for entities that no equal constraint takes.

ErrFittedSweep.text: ErrFittedSweep is SweepSteps' error for a sweep whose surface is fitted, not made of rigid steps: along a cubic, twisted, or held to a direction.

ErrMeshNotSound.text: ErrMeshNotSound is what an export wraps when Strict refuses a mesh that is not watertight or crosses itself.

ErrNoClosedRegion.text: ErrNoClosedRegion is returned when a group's sketch is not a closed region whose area can be taken.

ErrNoColor.text: Errors of the group options, for callers that say them in their own words.

ErrNoCombine.text: Errors of the group options, for callers that say them in their own words.

ErrNoConstraint.text: ErrNoConstraint is what an edit returns for a constraint the sketch does not have.

ErrNoRequest.text: ErrNoRequest is what an edit returns for a request the sketch does not have.

ErrNoSolidSuppress.text: ErrNoSolidSuppress is a solid suppressed of a group that has none of its own to leave out (see HasSolidSuppress).

ErrNormalLocked.text: ErrNormalLocked is what OrientNormal returns for a normal that nothing turns: one lying in a workplane, or copied from another group.

ErrNotCopies.text: ErrNotCopies is CopyPlacements' error for a group that makes no copies: not a step and repeat, a pattern along a path or a mirror.

ErrNotPoint.text: ErrNotPoint is returned by Overlap for an entity that isn't a point.

ErrNotTextRequest.text: ErrNotTextRequest is what the text edits return for a request that is not a TrueType text.

ErrSplinePointsFull.text: ErrSplinePointsFull is returned when a spline has as many points as an entity holds.

GroupChamfer.text: Groups of this program's own, which SolveSpace has no counterpart for.

GroupFillet.text: Groups of this program's own, which SolveSpace has no counterpart for.

GroupLoft.text: Groups of this program's own, which SolveSpace has no counterpart for.

GroupMirror.text: Groups of this program's own, which SolveSpace has no counterpart for.

GroupPathPattern.text: Groups of this program's own, which SolveSpace has no counterpart for.

GroupShell.text: Groups of this program's own, which SolveSpace has no counterpart for.

GroupSweep.text: Groups of this program's own, which SolveSpace has no counterpart for.

HGroupReferences.text: HGroupReferences is the handle value of the references group.

MaxUndo.text: MaxUndo is the depth of the undo and redo stacks.

RemapBottom.text: Remap keys for entity copies made by Group::Generate.

RemapLast.text: Remap keys for entity copies made by Group::Generate.

RemapLatheArcCenter.text: Remap keys for entity copies made by Group::Generate.

RemapLatheEnd.text: Remap keys for entity copies made by Group::Generate.

RemapLatheStart.text: Remap keys for entity copies made by Group::Generate.

RemapLineToFace.text: Remap keys for entity copies made by Group::Generate.

RemapPattern.text: RemapPattern is the remap copy number of a pattern's first copy.

RemapPtToArc.text: Remap keys for entity copies made by Group::Generate.

RemapPtToLine.text: Remap keys for entity copies made by Group::Generate.

RemapPtToNormal.text: Remap keys for entity copies made by Group::Generate.

RemapTop.text: Remap keys for entity copies made by Group::Generate.

SheetBorder.text: TitleBlockSize is the title block's size in mm, at the sheet's bottom right inside the border.

StandardScales.text: StandardScales are the scales a drawing picks from, largest first.

TitleBlockHeight.text: TitleBlockSize is the title block's size in mm, at the sheet's bottom right inside the border.

TitleBlockWidth.text: TitleBlockSize is the title block's size in mm, at the sheet's bottom right inside the border.

ViewKinds.text: ViewKinds are the kinds of view a drawing can show, in the order its screen lists them.

github.com/telesapr/telesapr/pkg/srf.name: srf
github.com/telesapr/telesapr/pkg/srf.text: Package srf is the geometry kernel: NURBS and Bézier curves, trimmed surfaces, watertight shells, BSP trees, and Boolean operations on surfaces and meshes.

Basis.text: Basis is the value at t of each of the curve's basis functions, one per control point, unweighted.

Beziers.text: Beziers cuts the curve at its knots into Bezier curves, each running over one span of the domain from 0 to 1.

Breaks.text: Breaks are the knots that cut the curve into Bezier pieces, the domain's ends included.

Check.text: Check reports what is wrong with the curve, or nil.

Domain.text: Domain is the curve's parameter range.

LowDegree.text: LowDegree is the curve, or one within tol of it of degree MaxDegree made of Bezier pieces, when its degree is above MaxDegree.

PointAt.text: PointAt is the curve's point at t.

WithKnot.text: WithKnot is the curve with t inserted once into its knots: the same curve, one control point more.

BSplineSurface.text: BSplineSurface is a tensor product B-spline surface: Ctrl[i][j] is the control point i along u and j along v.

Breaks.text: Breaks are the knots that cut the surface into patches, along u and along v, the domain's ends included.

Check.text: Check reports what is wrong with the surface, or nil.

Domain.decl: func (s *BSplineSurface) Domain() (u0, u1, v0, v1 float64)
Domain.text: Domain is the surface's parameter ranges.

IsoV.text: IsoV is the surface's curve at v, along u: its control points the columns' points at v, combined in homogeneous coordinates, of the surface's degree and knot vector along u.

LowDegree.text: LowDegree is the surface, or one within tol of it of degree at most MaxDegree each way, made of Bezier patches, when a degree is above MaxDegree.

Patches.text: Patches cuts the surface at its knots into Bezier patches: patches[a][b] runs over span a of the breaks along u and span b along v, its own parameters from 0 to 1 over them.

PointAt.text: PointAt is the surface's point at (u, v).

RemoveKnots.text: RemoveKnots takes out of the surface's knots inside its domain every copy it can without moving the surface more than tol, along u and then along v, and reports how many it took.

BspClass.text: BspClass is the side of a BSP node's plane something is on.

Class.text: Class is the relationship between a curve/edge and a face of the shell.

CurveSource.text: CurveSource tracks the provenance of a curve (used by SShell boolean operations to decide what to keep).

Derivs.text: Derivs evaluates a surface and its two first derivatives at (u, v).

EarType.text: EarType classifies a vertex for ear-clipping triangulation.

EdgeKind.text: EdgeKind classifies edges emitted by SMesh::MakeOutlinesInto.

EdgeOnInfo.text: EdgeOnInfo is what FindEdgeOn learns about an edge.

FaceFlag.text: FaceFlag controls mesh/shell rendering and CSG behavior.

FaceID.text: FaceID is a stable identifier for a face within a shell.

HalfSpace.text: HalfSpace is the points p with N.p <= D: what a section plane keeps, its normal N pointing to the side cut away.

Contains.text: Contains reports whether p is in the half space, or within LengthEps of its plane.

MeshMeta.text: MeshMeta is the colour/face tag attached to one triangle of an SMesh or to one surface of an SShell.

Mesher.text: Mesher is how a curved surface's trimmed region is triangulated.
